reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering cooked peppers, crop seeds, fish and shellfish, pet ownership, minerals, combat rings, preserves, a quest item, a cocktail, and tropical fruit were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established fish and glossary names, crop timing, gameplay effects, dynamic preserves naming, object gender, brand-style cocktail preservation, and pet-bowl semantics; both found no remaining objective issue.

PepperPoppers_Description.source: Spicy breaded peppers filled with cheese.
PepperPoppers_Description.translation: Ardei iuți pane, umpluți cu brânză.

PepperSeeds_Description.source: Plant these in the summer. Takes 5 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
PepperSeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le vara. Ajung la maturitate în 5 zile și continuă să producă după prima recoltă.

Perch_Description.source: A freshwater fish of the winter.
Perch_Description.translation: Un pește de apă dulce întâlnit iarna.

Periwinkle_Description.source: A tiny freshwater snail that lives in a blue shell.
Periwinkle_Description.translation: Un melc minuscul de apă dulce, care trăiește într-o cochilie albastră.

PetLicense_Description.source: Invite a new pet into your home. If you don't have enough outdoor pet bowls for your pets, they will become upset.
PetLicense_Description.translation: Primește un nou animal de companie în casa ta. Dacă nu ai suficiente boluri pentru animale de companie în aer liber, acestea se vor supăra.

PetrifiedSlime_Description.source: This little guy may be 100,000 years old.
PetrifiedSlime_Description.translation: Micuțul acesta ar putea avea 100.000 de ani.

PhoenixRing_Description.source: Once a day, regain some health after being knocked out in combat.
PhoenixRing_Description.translation: O dată pe zi, recapeți puțină sănătate după ce ești doborât în luptă.

Pickles_Description.source: A jar of your home-made pickles.
Pickles_Description.translation: Un borcan cu murături făcute în casă.

PierresMissingStocklist_Name.translation: Lista de stocuri pierdută a lui Pierre

PierresMissingStocklist_Description.source: Pierre might be interested in this.
PierresMissingStocklist_Description.translation: S-ar putea ca Pierre să fie interesat de ea.

Pike_Description.source: A freshwater fish that's difficult to catch.
Pike_Description.translation: Un pește de apă dulce greu de prins.

PinaColada_Name.preservationReason: Piña Colada is the standard cocktail name used unchanged in Romanian.

Pineapple_Description.source: A sweet and tangy tropical treat.
Pineapple_Description.translation: Un deliciu tropical dulce și acrișor.
